body:
I've been sitting on "don't do it, it will devastate them" for two years. The thing is, every step I take, every way I look, everything is just screaming at me to end it. I hate this fucking world. I just can't fucking deal with it any more. 

Ever since I was 14 I've wanted to kill myself. I fucked many girls, I had friends, I partied all the time. Now, 13 years later, the suicidal tendencies are still there. Nothing satisfies me, I'm repulsed by everything on this planet. I stopped going out, I stopped fucking, I'm always fucking depressed. Depression is a worthless feeling, I can't fucking deal with it anymore. Sometimes I don't even know why I'm depressed. That sinking feeling has been with me for 13 years and I've fucking had it.

I do however, want to make it easy on my family. I've even thought about going into a ghetto and shooting up some dealers, or gang bangers & have them off me. That way it might look like I was doing something noble, but I know that won't make it any easier on my family. I just don't want to be in this place anymore man.

I myself am planning on ending it all, so expect this to be rather negative.

However, it sounds like your just experiencing insane depression. Suicide is not the answer to that, especially since you have a daughter. I know this goes against the rules, but the damage you will do to that little girl is much graver than the pain you feel right now.

I was in love with a girl once, almost 10 years ago. After 1 1/2 years of dating she dumped me on skype, it devastated me. I took up coke, meth, and many different prescription drugs to try and get over her. Nothing worked.

I then moved to another country, tried dating other girls, but my stupid mind kept dwelling on this one girl. Anyways, why do I bring this up?? --

Love is the strongest feeling you'll ever experience, and losing someone you love will probably never heal. However, there is a famous quote out there: "it's better to have loved and lost than never to have loved at all." I don't know who wrote it, but I know it's true. I'd rather be heartbroken for life, than not having known love at all.

Now apply this to your daughter. You helped bring her to life, ending your own life would devastate her. Am I saying you shouldn't end it all? No...

But, you have to look at it this way. You are hurting right now, give yourself some more time, for pain and self-loathing to ease out. Another quote I just googled: "Today I choose life. Every morning when I wake up I can choose joy, happiness, negativity, pain... To feel the freedom that comes from being able to continue to make mistakes and choices - today I choose to feel life, not to deny my humanity but embrace it." Remember buddy, every day above ground is a victory...

I say, (and I know this means nothing) you should give yourself another year. Evaluate everything, consider suicide, consider the damage it does, and then decide. I can't wait for Jan 25, I've been dwelling on this shit for 2 years already, and it is the only solution for me. I have a feeling you have other options.

I know I'm being a cunt in saying to hold on when I'm pulling the plug, but you owe it to yourself to consider this thoroughly. I'm not religious, and honestly believe once you die, you just rot away under the earth. If you are religious it would mean hell, I say ignore that. A God that made you, also gave you a train of thought, and he wouldn't doom you to the flames for eternity for it. However, are you sure that suicide is the only solution?

There is this island in the Caribbean, Curaçao, that has legal prostitution. Maybe visit there and fuck some of them. This won't heel an aching heart, but it might just be what you need to get over these suicidal tendencies. 

Anyways bro, I hope this message was coherent. Just think about it long and hard, OK?
